The woman points toward the camera while seated at a table. (3) A close-up of a printed menu shows various unique vegetarian rice and hotpot options. A finger points specifically at items like Apple Rice and Pumpkin Rice. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the clear text on the white paper. (4) A young man in a grey collared shirt appears on screen, gesturing energetically with a smile. He holds a menu and a wallet, interacting with the woman. The background shows the restaurant's serving counter and bright indoor lighting. Steam rises from the dish, and the textures of the sauce and mushrooms are clearly visible in the macro shot. (6) The woman eats a spoonful of rice topped with the sizzling tofu. She talks to the camera, gesturing with her chopsticks. The camera captures her head and shoulders, showing her necklace and earrings against the white background. (7) Detailed close-ups of the food reveal the composition of the iron plate dish, showing chopped herbs, black pepper grains, and the translucent texture of the noodles. She takes a bite and displays an emotional facial expression, closing her eyes and nodding. (9) The scene shifts to the exterior of a second restaurant named 'Chi Ruo Ya' at dusk. The building has a wooden fence and a small garden. The woman walks toward the entrance, waving. (10) Inside the second restaurant, the atmosphere is warmer with soft yellow lighting. The woman sits at a wooden table. A menu with color photos is shown, followed by close-ups of fried mushrooms, tomato eggs, and other vegetarian specialties. (11) A male and female character are shown eating together, using chopsticks to share dishes. The camera captures their expressions of enjoyment. Several other family members are briefly seen in the background. (12) The final sequence features a montage of people eating, smiling, and reacting to the food, concluding with group shots in the warm restaurant setting.
